_about: Open threat feeds of malicious / removed browser extension IDs. Every fleet extension is
matched against every feed on each scoring cycle; a hit adds a threat-feed:<name> signal.
Add a feed by adding an entry; no code change or rebuild (read at the start of each cycle).
Fields: name (a-z0-9_-), url (https, public host), format ('csv'), platform ('chromium' covers
chrome/edge/brave/opera/vivaldi/chromium IDs; 'firefox' covers AMO GUIDs), id_field (column with
the extension ID), optional reason_field / source_field / date_field (columns), optional
default_reason (used when the feed has no reason column), added_at (ISO 8601 UTC), license.
Reason text sets severity: malware/spyware/phishing/stealer => known-bad (risk >= 85);
adware/hijacking/bundling/suspicious => risk >= 70; anything else (policy takedown) => risk >= 60.
Mozilla's own blocklist is built in (version-aware) and is not configured here.
